assertions.statement: The home page loads with no wallet connected, calls the free endpoint and shows its JSON, and offers a paid call that names the price in HBAR or tinybar.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to the app root. Trigger the free endpoint and confirm a JSON reading is rendered. Confirm a control for the paid call exists and that the price is stated on screen.

assertions.statement: With the burner key present in localStorage under burnerWallet.pk, the paid call completes and the UI shows a settled payment with its Hedera transaction id.
assertions.howToVerify: The burner key is injected before the page loads. Trigger the paid call. Confirm the UI reports success and displays a transaction id shaped 0.0.N@seconds.nanos. A 402 that never resolves, or a success with no transaction id, is a failure.

assertions.statement: The receipt feed lists at least one x402.receipt.v1 receipt read back from the mirror node, carrying the settlement transaction id.
assertions.howToVerify: After the paid call, open the receipt view. Confirm at least one receipt is listed and that a transaction id is shown. The receipts are read from HANVIL_MIRROR_URL, not from in-memory state.

assertions.statement: The admin page shows the facilitator URL, the payTo account and the HCS topic in use, and does not display any private key.
assertions.howToVerify: Navigate to /admin. Confirm the three values are shown. Search the visible text for a 64-hex or 0x-prefixed private key; finding one is a failure.

assertions.statement: An EVM-only wallet is refused with a message naming the reason, rather than failing silently or appearing to work.
assertions.howToVerify: Look for the wallet selection affordance. Confirm the UI states that an EVM-only wallet such as MetaMask cannot sign a Hedera transfer, either as a disabled option with an explanation or as an error shown on selection. Judge the affordance and the copy; do not install a wallet.
